name: mg_read_runtime
description: MgRead standalone Plugin Runtime baseline: complete runtime ownership, shared protocol, and future Flutter-facing facade.

scripts.build: npm run check:toolchain && node tools/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/copy-debug-ui-assets.mjs && node tools/stage-flutter-android-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:flutter-desktop: npm run build && cd packages/mgread_plugin_runtime && flutter pub get && flutter test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:no-native-addons
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run verify && npm run test:flutter-desktop
